pages.title: Crafting a Rune Table
pages.text: A Rune Table extracts and stores runes from golden Reflection Orbs. Right-click the block to open its orb slot and storage display.

pages.title: Extracting Runes
pages.text: Place a filled golden orb in the slot. It rises above the table and extraction begins. After about 5 minutes, the table gains 100 runes and the orb loses 1 durability. It returns to blue while durability remains, but is consumed after its fifth extraction.

pages.title: Capacity and Pausing
pages.text: A Rune Table stores up to 500 runes.
